comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Can be plundered from Cobavich Lv70, who hangs out in the Lake Baikal Region which is accessed from the Sea of Okhotsk West Coast landing point in the Sea of Okhotsk (no pre-discovery needed to enter Baikal unlike most inland zones but you will have to chart nearly the Northeast Passage to reach the sea in question). Stats:

Search +2
3k total fame to equip, unisex.

Source: tyojyuhei.web.fc2.com/dol_head.html
